bindVars.description: Bind variable values for the statement.

connection.description: Connection string for the data source that issued the database request.

time.description: Elapsed time (in milliseconds) for the query to be executed by the database (does not include retrieving any results).

plan.description: Query execution plan returned by the backend database for the issued statement.

estimatedRowCount.description: For those datastores that support it, the estimated number of rows that will be returned by the query.

title: Database query plan returned in {@link FetchResult#queryPlans} if {@link FetchSpec#explain} is set to true.
name: QueryPlan
